name: PUPA
description: Write a Python solve(user_query, llm, untrusted_llm) program that answers private user requests with a trusted model and, optionally, an external untrusted model; a judge model scores each item as (quality + (1 - PII leakage to the untrusted model)) / 2, averaged over a fixed 20-item sample of GEPA's PUPA test split (higher is better).

sources.locator: papillon_data.py split, papillon_program.py pipeline, papillon_utils.py judge metric

requirements.hardware: See upstream requirements and task notes.
notes: OPENAI_API_KEY and WANDB_API_KEY are asserted even for baseline mode. Setup requires the patched DSPy fork installed by setup_gepa_repo.sh, uv sync, dataset access, and benchmark-specific retrieval services. See benchmark program source.

commands.notes: Task-specific original artifact Baseline evaluation. Benchmark index/order, program 0 class and LM config verified in get_benchmarks(), benchmark __init__.py files and LM_CONFIGS[1]. Uses paid model calls; OPENAI_API_KEY and WANDB_API_KEY required. Does not perform GEPA optimization.

notes: Exact source-valid per-task Baseline command with explicit benchmark/program selectors. Full GEPA runs additionally require optimizer budget/cache configuration; baseline evaluation alone does not reproduce optimized paper results.

limitations: Execution interface inspected in pinned source. Full paper experiments have not been reproduced here.
